question: Identify users who have posted at least one child post (a post with a non-null ParentId), whose display names start with ‘J’, are adults aged between 19 and 65, and have received at least one badge. Return only their display names.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033"
INNER JOIN badges AS T3 ON T1."XCL_052" = T3."XCL_002"
WHERE T2."XCL_043" IS NOT NULL
  AND T1."XCL_055" LIKE 'J%'
  AND T1."XCL_064" BETWEEN 19 AND 65
